decisions.statement: A list the game wrote sparsely and one it wrote as a record say the same thing.
A recipe is known where the game says known, and the rest are left out.
Only the crafting motif category of the lore library counts as motif knowledge.
Every character holds a motif chapter map, empty where the game wrote none.
A trait a character has yet to research is recorded as unknown.
Bank stock is what the Bank location holds and nothing else.
Only a location keyed by digits alone counts as a character for stock.
A script is recorded by the item id its name resolves to.

definition: what each character knows and what the account has of what they want
